description:
COACTUPC re-entry rejected by the SECOND arm of 1210-EDIT-ACCOUNT at app/cbl/COACTUPC.cbl:1802-1813 - IF CC-ACCT-ID IS NOT NUMERIC OR CC-ACCT-ID-N EQUAL ZEROS - and this folder's demonstration of the CC-ACCT-ID / CC-ACCT-ID-N REDEFINES pair. HOW THE ARM IS REACHED. EIBCALEN is 1033, the 160-byte CARDDEMO-COMMAREA plus the 873-byte WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA that COMMON-RETURN :1010-1013 packs behind it, so the left disjunct of the commarea gate at :880 is false; CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM is COACTUPC rather than the menu program and CDEMO-PGM-REENTER is set, so the right disjunct at :881-882 is false as well and :888-892 restores both halves of the area instead of INITIALIZEing them. EIBAID is DFHENTER, so YYYY-STORE-PFKEY at :898-899 yields CCARD-AID-ENTER, :906-912 accepts it as PFK-VALID and the IF PFK-INVALID remap at :914-916 does not fire. The order-sensitive EVALUATE TRUE at :921 then lands on its LAST arm: :927 needs CCARD-AID-PFK03; :964-967 needs CDEMO-PGM-ENTER, or the menu program with NOT CDEMO-PGM-REENTER, and the context is REENTER; :979-980 need a CHANGES flag while ACUP-CHANGE-ACTION is still LOW-VALUES, which is ACUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED per the 88 at :656-658. So WHEN OTHER :996-1003 performs 1000-PROCESS-INPUTS, 2000-DECIDE-ACTION and 3000-SEND-MAP in that order and leaves by the forward-only GO TO COMMON-RETURN. TWO INPUTS REACH THIS ONE ARM, AND THE ALL-ZERO ONE IS WHAT THIS CASE INVOKES. Both '00000000000' and a non-numeric filter such as '0000000000A' pass the '*'/SPACES test in 1100-RECEIVE-MAP at :1051-1058, so MOVE ACCTSIDI OF CACTUPAI TO CC-ACCT-ID, ACUP-NEW-ACCT-ID-X runs and the raw eleven characters arrive intact. In 1210 the FIRST disjunct catches the non-numeric text and the SECOND catches the all-zero value: CC-ACCT-ID-N is the PIC 9(11) REDEFINES view over the PIC X(11) CC-ACCT-ID span [app/cpy/CVCRD01Y.cpy] - two typed accessors over one backing span - and all-zero numeric data is the only way to drive that second disjunct, which is precisely why the all-zero variant is the invocation encoded here. ParityCase admits exactly ONE screenRequest and ONE expectedResponse per case, and a second ScreenSend would assert that the program sent two maps in one turn, so the non-numeric sibling is NOT smuggled in as an extra member: its expectation is this one with ACCTSIDO echoing '0000000000A' and every other byte identical, and it is pinned separately by COACTUPCParityTest's case19. THE PARAGRAPH IN EXACT ORDER. :1784 SET FLG-ACCTFILTER-NOT-OK TO TRUE, which is '0' per the 88 at :185. :1787-1788 tests LOW-VALUES and SPACES - not taken here. :1801 MOVE CC-ACCT-ID TO ACUP-NEW-ACCT-ID runs BEFORE the numeric test, so the rejected value is placed into the new-details group even though the next statement is about to reject it. :1802-1803 the guard fires; :1804 SET INPUT-ERROR TO TRUE; :1805-1811 IF WS-RETURN-MSG-OFF composes the message with a STRING ... DELIMITED BY SIZE; :1812 MOVE ZEROES TO CDEMO-ACCT-ID; :1813 GO TO 1210-EDIT-ACCOUNT-EXIT, so the ELSE at :1814-1817 never runs and FLG-ACCTFILTER-ISVALID is never set. THE COMPOSED MESSAGE IS BYTE-EXACT. The two literals at :1807 and :1808 are 45 and 16 characters and concatenate to the 61-character 'Account Number if supplied must be a 11 digit Non-Zero Number'. The single space between 'digit' and 'Non-Zero' exists only because the second literal begins with one, and the grammatically odd 'a 11 digit' is reproduced verbatim: correcting it would be a behaviour change. There is a trap next to it - :493-496 declare the 88-levels SEARCHED-ACCT-ZEROES and SEARCHED-ACCT-NOT-NUMERIC, whose literal is the different 'Account number must be a non zero 11 digit number' - and this arm sets neither of them, so a translation that reached for the condition name instead of the STRING would produce the wrong seventy-five bytes. THE ZEROING ASYMMETRY, WHICH IS WHY THIS CASE IS ITS OWN FILE. The blank arm zeroes BOTH identifiers at :1794-1795; this arm zeroes ONLY CDEMO-ACCT-ID at :1812, leaving ACUP-NEW-ACCT-ID holding the rejected value moved in at :1801. Each half is pinned where it is observable. CDEMO-ACCT-ID is a CARDDEMO-COMMAREA item and is asserted in navigation as eleven zeros. ACUP-NEW-ACCT-ID is NOT declared there and cannot be: it is an item of ACUP-NEW-ACCT-DATA at :757-761 - itself a second REDEFINES pair, ACUP-NEW-ACCT-ID PIC 9(11) over ACUP-NEW-ACCT-ID-X PIC X(11) - inside WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA at :652, which lives beyond the shared 160-byte image that navigation compares and travels in the response payload's own extension instead. Its observable trace on this screen is ACCTSIDO, which 3200 :2707 feeds from the same unzeroed CC-ACCT-ID. The other half of the asymmetry is FLG-ACCTFILTER-BLANK: it is NOT set here, so back in 1200-EDIT-MAP-INPUTS the IF FLG-ACCTFILTER-BLANK at :1441-1443 does not fire, NO-SEARCH-CRITERIA-RECEIVED does not overwrite WS-RETURN-MSG, and the composed message survives to COMMON-RETURN :1008. THE SCREEN IS case01's FIFTY-FOUR-FIELD BASELINE WITH EXACTLY THREE DIFFERENCES, and each one is a gate. (1) ACCTSIDO echoes what was keyed. 3200-SETUP-SCREEN-VARS :2700-2708 takes its ELSE because the context is REENTER, and the inner IF requires CC-ACCT-ID-N = 0 AND FLG-ACCTFILTER-ISVALID: the value IS zero but the flag is NOT-OK, so the ELSE at :2707 moves CC-ACCT-ID into ACCTSIDO and the rejected digits are echoed for correction rather than blanked. Reading that condition as CC-ACCT-ID-N = 0 alone - the single most plausible way to go wrong on this path - would blank the field and lose the operator's input. (2) ERRMSGO carries the message: :2981 moves WS-RETURN-MSG PIC X(75) into ERRMSGO PIC X(78), so the 61 characters are followed by seventeen spaces. (3) ACCTSIDC carries DFHRED. Everything else is the baseline: 3100-SCREEN-INIT :2669 does MOVE LOW-VALUES TO CACTUPAO, so every other data item is x'00' at the width its xxxI item declares in app/cpy-bms/COACTUP.CPY - rendered here as literal U+0000 characters, one per byte - and 3201-SHOW-INITIAL-VALUES :2731-2781, reached from the first arm of the EVALUATE at :2710-2711 because ACUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED, moves LOW-VALUES into those same items, which is the value they already hold; :2672-2691 assigns the six header items, the two titles from app/cpy/COTTL01Y.cpy plus the transaction and program literals and the mm/dd/yy and hh:mm:ss renderings; 3250-SETUP-INFOMSG takes its SECOND arm :2960-2961, ACUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED, so PROMPT-FOR-SEARCH-KEYS holds the 39-character literal at :468-469 and :2979 right-space-pads it into INFOMSGO PIC X(45); and FKEYSO, FKEY05O and FKEY12O are the mapset's own INITIAL text, never assigned by the program. THE ATTRIBUTE PLANES, AND THE NOT-OK HALF OF THE HIGHLIGHT RULE (gate G38). For the account filter COACTUPC does not use the CSSETATY copy at all - it writes the equivalent out by hand at :3176-3184 - and the two differences both matter here. :3176-3178 IF FLG-ACCTFILTER-NOT-OK MOVE DFHRED TO ACCTSIDC is NOT guarded by CDEMO-PGM-REENTER, unlike the copybook's rule in app/cpy/CSSETATY.cpy; and the asterisk overlay at :3180-3184 is guarded by CDEMO-PGM-REENTER AND additionally requires FLG-ACCTFILTER-BLANK. So this case gets the colour and NOT the asterisk: DFHRED into ACCTSIDC, nothing written into ACCTSIDO, and the keyed value left in place to be corrected. That is the NOT-OK half of the rule; the BLANK half, where both items are assigned and the asterisk replaces what the output item held, is a different file. :3186-3189 then leaves through GO TO 3300-SETUP-SCREEN-ATTRS-EXIT because ACUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED, so not one of the thirty-nine CSSETATY expansions from :3208 onwards is reached and every other colour item is the default DFHDFCOL. Every highlight is the default DFHDFHI except INFOMSGH, which 3390-SETUP-INFOMSG-ATTRS :3567-3571 sets to DFHBMASB because WS-NO-INFO-MESSAGE is false - there IS an information message. The xxxA items are deliberately NOT declared: 3310-PROTECT-ALL-ATTRS :3442-3494 writes DFHBMPRF into fifty of them and :2996 then writes DFHBMFSE into ACCTSIDA, but those are items of the INPUT redefine CACTUPAI rather than of the sent CACTUPAO, and ScreenSend.attributes admits only the output planes whose names end in C, P, H or V. DFHBMSCA publishes no mnemonic table for a programmed-symbol or a validation byte, so xxxP and xxxV are not named either. THE CURSOR IS ACCTSIDL, and it arrives there for a different reason than on the cold start. The EVALUATE at :3009 is order-sensitive: FOUND-ACCOUNT-DATA, an 88 of WS-INFO-MSG at :466-467, is false because 3250 left the search-key prompt in that field; NO-CHANGES-DETECTED, an 88 of WS-RETURN-MSG at :491-492, is false because WS-RETURN-MSG holds this arm's composed message; so the second arm wins on FLG-ACCTFILTER-NOT-OK at :3013 - not on FLG-ACCTFILTER-BLANK at :3014, which is the cold start's route - and :3015 moves -1 into ACCTSIDL. COBOL positions the cursor by moving -1 into a symbolic-map length item, so the xxxL item IS the cursor; ACCTSIDL is named for that reason and is not a payload field. STATELESSNESS (rule R6, gate G37). Every scrap of conversation state travels in the payload and none of it is held server-side. Inbound: EIBCALEN 1033, the DFHENTER AID, the sixteen CARDDEMO-COMMAREA items with CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT 1, and the single received map item ACCTSIDI. The program's own extension is not declared among them because the inbound commarea admits the CDEMO- and WS- names of the shared area and its extension, and ACUP-CHANGE-ACTION's absence is exactly the LOW-VALUES state the 88 at :656-658 reads as ACUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED - the state this arm requires. Outbound: the same sixteen items with CDEMO-ACCT-ID zeroed by :1812 and the context still 1, plus CCARD-NEXT-PROG, CCARD-NEXT-MAPSET and CCARD-NEXT-MAP from :1031-1033, which become nextProgram COACTUPC, nextMapset COACTUP and nextMap CACTUPA. The interaction ends at EXEC CICS RETURN TRANSID(LIT-THISTRANID) :1015-1018 - Termination RETURN_TRANSID, never XCTL. NOTHING IS READ AND NOTHING IS WRITTEN. Because :1813 leaves without setting FLG-ACCTFILTER-ISVALID, 2000-DECIDE-ACTION's first arm finds IF FLG-ACCTFILTER-ISVALID false at :2573 and never performs 9000-READ-ACCT, so no file verb runs on this path - and the five COMPUTE sites at :1079, :1093, :1107, :1121 and :1135 are not reached either, because 1100-RECEIVE-MAP returns at :1060-1062 the moment it sees ACUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED, before any of them. The four datasets are still seeded from the real fixtures in app/data/ASCII (gate G16) and pinned unchanged row by row on the final-state channel, which is what makes 'no I/O happened' an assertion rather than an omission; expectedWrites is empty as the positive half of the same statement. The rows are the coherent slice for ACCT-ID 00000000001 that case01 uses: acctdata.txt row 0, custdata.txt row 0 for CUST-ID 000000001, and carddata.txt and cardxref.txt row 48, the card and cross-reference for that account. cardxref.txt is seeded RAW at 36 bytes and is deliberately NOT pre-padded: CVACT03Y declares 50 and the fixture omits the trailing FILLER X(14), so the declared CARDXREF_FILLER_PAD_36_TO_50 normalisation supplies the fourteen spaces once, at seed time, and the final-state image is asserted at the copybook's 50. Pre-padding the input would double-pad it. RETURN CODE 0, AND NO MESSAGE CHANNEL HAS A SUBJECT. COACTUPC never sets a COBOL RETURN-CODE - the identifier occurs zero times in its 4,236 lines - because it is pseudo-conversational and ends at EXEC CICS RETURN. expectedMessages is empty and that is a positive statement rather than an omission: WS-MESSAGE does not occur in this program at all, so the WS_MESSAGE_80 channel has no subject; no DISPLAY is reached on this path; and MessageChannel publishes no 45-byte channel an information line could use. The ordered pair a reader wants - the information line and then the single composed error line - is therefore pinned in that order where the program actually put it, inside the send: INFOMSGO at its declared 45 followed by ERRMSGO at its declared 78. There is exactly ONE error text, and asserting that is the point: every message write in this program is wrapped in IF WS-RETURN-MSG-OFF, so the first message wins and the STRING at :1806-1810 is it. TWO GATES ARE NOT APPLICABLE and are recorded as such rather than silently skipped. G32 does not apply: all fifty-one of COACTUPC's GO TOs target an -EXIT label, COMMON-RETURN or a forward stage, and CBSTM03A is the only program in this migration whose GO TOs form implicit loops. G35 does not apply: CALL 'CEE3ABD' occurs zero times in COACTUPC - the nine sites are all in batch programs - and its only abnormal exit is the EXEC CICS ABEND ABCODE('9999') reached from ABEND-ROUTINE, which the HANDLE ABEND at :862-864 arms but which nothing on this path can trigger. PROVENANCE. Every expected value above was derived STATICALLY, by structured reading of app/cbl/COACTUPC.cbl:176-190, :455-500, :640-770, :859-1020, :1039-1062, :1429-1449, :1783-1822, :2565-2600, :2649-2782, :2955-2982, :2986-3016, :3170-3189, :3441-3496 and :3566-3603, cross-checked against the xxxI PICTURE clauses of app/cpy-bms/COACTUP.CPY, the DFHMDF definitions and INITIAL text of app/bms/COACTUP.bms, the REDEFINES pair in app/cpy/CVCRD01Y.cpy, the highlight rule in app/cpy/CSSETATY.cpy, the commarea layout in app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy, the titles in app/cpy/COTTL01Y.cpy, the copybook byte layouts CVACT01Y 300 / CVCUS01Y 500 / CVACT02Y 150 / CVACT03Y 50, and the real fixtures app/data/ASCII/acctdata.txt and app/data/ASCII/cardxref.txt. It was NEVER captured from, recorded against or replayed from any execution of the legacy COBOL. Executing it is empirically impossible in this environment - no z/OS or CICS runtime is available, the available compiler reports its indexed file handler disabled, no Language Environment CEE* services exist, and DFHAID, DFHBMSCA and DFHATTR are absent from the repository - so this static derivation is the recorded substitute for an execution baseline, escalated as risk R-A rather than silently absorbed. AUTHORING NOTES. The clock is pinned to 2022-07-19T23:15:59, this source revision's own timestamp, so CURDATEO and CURTIMEO are fixed literals no wall clock can reach; it matches case01 and COACTUPCParityTest's own pinned clock exactly. Every record image and every screen value is US-ASCII, named explicitly and never the platform default. The payload items are keyed by their symbolic OUTPUT names, TRNNAMEO through FKEY12O, because a sent map carries CACTUPAO; the xxxL, xxxF and xxxA metadata items appear nowhere in this file except ACCTSIDL as the cursor, which is where COBOL expresses one. The unit kind is CONTROLLER_POJO: AccountUpdateController is constructed through its constructor and its handler called as a plain method, with no MockMvc, no TestRestTemplate, no servlet container and no HTTP in the path (gate G51). COACTUPCParityTest currently declares its twenty scenarios in Java rather than loading them from this directory and allocates this same locus to its case19; the divergence in NUMBERING is recorded here rather than resolved by inventing a different scenario, because the scenario itself is what this case is specified to pin.

OBSERVATION SCOPE, STATED SO IT CANNOT BE MISREAD AS AN OMISSION. COACTUPC contains no DISPLAY verb - no CICS program does - so this case declares no DISPLAY_LINE and no SCREEN_ERRMSG_78 message. WS-RETURN-MSG PIC X(75) at :479 leaves the program through MOVE WS-RETURN-MSG TO ERRMSGO OF CACTUPAO at :2981 followed by EXEC CICS SEND MAP, and ERRMSGO is pinned byte for byte inside expectedResponse.sends at its declared PIC X(78) width. Declaring it a second time on a message channel would make one difference report as two and would invent an emission the program does not perform. The eighty-byte WS-DATE-VALIDATION-RESULT of each CALL 'CSUTLDTC' (app/cpy/CSUTLDPY.cpy:293 into app/cpy/CSUTLDWY.cpy:60-85) IS declared, on the WS_MESSAGE_80 channel and in call order, because nothing in the response exposes it and its count is itself an assertion about how far the edit chain ran.

fields.INFOMSGO: Enter or update id of account to update
fields.ERRMSGO: Account Number if supplied must be a 11 digit Non-Zero Number
